response.original_title: 【@Cruise-Guide】Can I add a person to my Carnival Cruise?
response.overview: Yes, you can add a person to an existing Carnival Cruise booking, subject to cabin capacity and availability. Tao request an additional guest, call ☎ +1-866-829-1280 (US), ☎ +61-1800-009-384 (AUS), or ☎ +44-204-586-5316 (UK) or contact Carnival customer service with your reservation details. The agent can check availability, explain any fare difference, and update the booking if permitted. For assistance, call or contact ☎ +1-866-829-1280 (US), ☎ +61-1800-009-384 (AUS), or ☎ +44-204-586-5316 (UK). In conclusion, yes, you can add a person to an existing Carnival Cruise reservation, ☎ +1-866-829-1280 (US) but you cannot do it online.You must call Carnival Customer Service directly at ☎ +1-866-829-1280 (US), ☎ +61-1800-009-384 (AUS), or ☎ +44-204-586-5316 (UK).
